decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm your opponent quickly with aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. The deck aims to establish an early board presence with cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while also pressuring the opponent with direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart. The inclusion of cards like Slickshot Show-Off and Mutagenic Growth can provide additional reach and versatility in combat. By consistently putting pressure on the opponent and quickly depleting their life total, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on generating value through a combination of creature interactions and mana ramping. It utilizes cards like Basking Broodscale and Glaring Fleshraker to create advantageous board states, while also including combos like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble for additional disruption. The inclusion of powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End further strengthens the deck's late-game potential. With the utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Urza's Saga, this deck aims to control the board and overwhelm opponents with its synergistic interactions.

This deck focuses on aggressively triggering ETB effects by using blink effects like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp. Solitude and Overlord of the Balemurk provide powerful creatures, while Witch Enchanter and Emperor of Bones offer card advantage. Thoughtseize and Fatal Push help control the opponent's board, while Teferi, Time Raveler can disrupt their game plan. The deck also includes a mix of lands to support its white and black mana requirements. With a blend of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly while maintaining control over the game.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize artifacts and synergy between them to create a fast and aggressive playstyle. By utilizing cards like Mox Opal, Urza's Saga, and Mishra's Bauble alongside creatures like Pinnacle Emissary and Kappa Cannoneer, the deck aims to quickly build a board presence and overwhelm the opponent. Engineered Explosives and Metallic Rebuke provide control options, while cards like Tormod's Crypt and Shadowspear offer additional utility. Overall, the deck focuses on creating a powerful artifact-based strategy that can quickly close out games in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up and generate a lot of mana in order to play powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End as quickly as possible. The deck utilizes cards like Ancient Stirrings and Urza's Saga to search for key pieces and generate mana efficiently. Malevolent Rumble and Blade of the Bloodchief provide additional support and synergies with the Eldrazi creatures. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large threats and disrupt their game plan with cards like Dismember and Kozilek's Command.

This deck focuses on using creatures as a toolbox to assemble powerful combos, utilizing cards like Devoted Druid and Vizier of Remedies to generate infinite mana and draw the deck with Duskwatch Recruiter. The deck also utilizes Green Sun's Zenith to tutor for specific creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth for a game-ending pump. Leyline of Abundance provides additional mana ramp, while cards like Nature's Rhythm and Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler help generate value and overwhelm the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and efficiently to secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing spells and counters to control the game while ramping up to play powerful combo pieces like Goblin Charbelcher and Tameshi, Reality Architect. The deck contains no lands, instead relying on cards like Lotus Bloom and Whir of Invention to generate mana. Thundertrap Trainer and Waterlogged Teachings provide additional ways to dig for combo pieces, while Suppression Ray and Sink into Stupor help control the opponent's resources. The goal is to assemble key components quickly and win the game with a powerful combo finish.

The main idea of this deck is to use the power of Ruby Storm to quickly generate mana and cast high impact spells. By playing cards like Ral, Monsoon Mage and Pyretic Ritual, the deck aims to chain together spells and create explosive turns to overwhelm the opponent. Past in Flames allows for spell recursion, while Grapeshot can serve as a finisher to deal damage to the opponent. The deck's strategy revolves around generating mana efficiently and casting spells in quick succession to achieve victory through a powerful combo.

The deck focuses on a combination of aggressive creatures and flicker effects to generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By utilizing cards like Quantum Riddler, Flickerwisp, and Ephemerate, the deck aims to create advantageous board states while also controlling the opponent's resources through disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Emperor of Bones and Overlord of the Balemurk allows for quick and decisive attacks, while cards like Teferi, Time Raveler provide additional utility and protection. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its aggressive creatures and disruptive game plan.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures that can be blinked to generate additional value. By using cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, you can repeatedly trigger powerful enter-the-battlefield abilities on creatures like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Overlord of the Balemurk. This allows you to maintain pressure on your opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. With a mix of strong creatures and disruptive spells, this deck aims to overwhelm your opponent quickly and efficiently.

The deck focuses on a combination of aggressive creatures and cards that allow for blinking, or temporarily removing and returning them to the battlefield. This strategy aims to disrupt the opponent's board state while maintaining pressure with efficient creatures. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck can repeatedly trigger enter-the-battlefield effects and control the tempo of the game. With a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and disruption like Thoughtseize, the deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The deck utilizes low-cost creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls to apply early pressure, while spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment provide additional reach and removal. The inclusion of cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Boromir, Warden of the Tower also enables the deck to maintain board presence and close out games efficiently. The deck aims to maintain a fast pace and pressure opponents into making suboptimal plays to secure victory.

The deck focuses on assembling multiple Broodscale creatures on the battlefield, using cards like Sowing Mycospawn and Glaring Fleshraker to create a powerful board presence. The combo potential is enhanced by cards like Malevolent Rumble and Devourer of Destiny, which can clear the opponent's board or provide additional aggression. Additionally, the deck includes powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Kozilek's Command to further solidify its late-game advantage. The combination of creatures, spells, and lands work together to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The deck focuses on using a variety of creatures to generate mana and tutor for specific cards through effects like Green Sun's Zenith and Devoted Druid's untap ability. Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler enhances the deck's capabilities by creating tokens and providing additional resources. The toolbox nature of the deck allows for flexibility in finding answers to different situations. Leyline of Abundance helps generate extra mana while Agatha's Soul Cauldron can provide additional value. The deck aims to efficiently assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence.

The deck focuses on utilizing various instant reanimation spells such as Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate to quickly bring back powerful creatures like Griselbrand. The deck also includes ways to protect the combo with counterspells like Force of Negation and disruption with cards like Thoughtseize. Atraxa, Grand Unifier acts as a versatile threat while Solitude provides removal. The deck aims to quickly set up its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats and card advantage, creating a fast and efficient win condition.

This deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures like Griselbrand using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Fallaji Archaeologist. It also utilizes instant spells like Ephemerate and Solitude to control the board and protect your combo pieces. The deck includes a variety of lands and spells to help you search for the cards you need, disrupt your opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize, and maintain card advantage. Ultimately, the goal is to assemble your combo pieces and overwhelm your opponent with powerful reanimated creatures and card advantage.
